The '''senator''' that represented the industrial [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Peg Shar I/Legends|Peg Shar I]], which they also [[Homeworld/Legends|from]], in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Inside" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, as depicted in ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> had an office on a lower level of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the Republic.<ref name="Inside" />

==Behind the scenes==
The senator was mentioned in the [[2000]] reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars: Episode I]]'', which was written by [[Kristin Lund]].<ref name="Inside" />
